recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes the applied ownership transfer in active core source metadata without changing Substance semantics; no additional tightly related ownership issue was found.
issue_request: FHIR-30796 requested changing ownership of the Substance resource after a joint OO/BRR WGM vote; Jira is Published with Persuasive resolution and Applied for R5.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit ef7cfcb850 changed source/fhir.ini from substance=oo to substance=brr, but did not update all checked-in Substance metadata. The StructureDefinition still declared oo and OO publisher/contact metadata, and the Substance category value set had a brr workgroup extension but still named the OO workgroup as publisher/contact.
additional_context: The linked OO WGM minutes record that Substance resource ownership was still listing OO, approve transferring maintenance to BRR, and action changing ownership in the FHIR build. The linked Zulip topic confirms fhir.ini is the build-level owner source and StructureDefinitions should reflect/regenerate from it. Current source/fhir.ini actively lists substance=Substance and assigns substance=brr.
reconciliation: Updated source/substance/structuredefinition-Substance.xml to use brr, the BR&R publisher, and the BR&R committee contact. Removed stale OO publisher/contact metadata from source/substance/valueset-substance-category.xml while retaining its already-correct brr workgroup extension and matching neighboring Substance terminology publisher/contact style.

source/substance/valueset-substance-category.xml: removed stale Orders and Observations publisher/contact metadata from the bound Substance category value set, preserving its brr workgroup extension and aligning contact metadata with neighboring FHIR Project terminology resources.
